categories.main_business_segments: Beijing Enterprises Holdings Limited operates primarily in four main business segments: Gas Business, Water Business, Environmental Business, and Beer Business. The Gas Business includes natural gas storage, transmission, sales, pipeline construction, LNG trade, and related services. The Water Business, led by BE Water, focuses on urban water supply, sewage treatment, and water-related environmental protection. The Environmental Business involves solid waste treatment, waste incineration and power generation, and related environmental services, including operations in Europe through EEW GmbH. The Beer Business, represented by Yanjing Brewery, engages in beer production and sales.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies in natural gas processing and distribution, including LNG processing and pipeline transmission. In water treatment, it integrates industrial investment, design, construction, operation, and technical services, with a focus on water recycling and environmental protection. The Environmental Business utilizes world-leading waste incineration technology and project management standards, including sludge and flue gas drying technologies. The Beer Business emphasizes digital transformation in supply chain and production, energy conservation, and green brewing processes. The Group also invests in R&D for new energy and environmental technologies, including carbon capture and utilization.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers include residential, commercial, industrial, and public sector users of natural gas and water services in China, particularly in Beijing and surrounding regions. The Environmental Business serves municipal governments and industrial clients for solid waste treatment and energy generation in China and Europe. The Beer Business targets consumers across China with a focus on medium- and high-end markets. The Group’s gas trading and LNG businesses also engage in international markets, including global LNG trade. Overall, the Group serves urban infrastructure, public utilities, and consumer markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group operates mainly in Mainland China, with significant presence in Beijing and other provinces, municipalities, and autonomous regions. It also has overseas operations, notably in Germany, the Netherlands, Luxembourg, Russia, Portugal, Singapore, Australia, and Saudi Arabia. The Environmental Business has 17 waste-to-energy plants in Europe, and the LNG trade has international reach. The Beer Business operates production bases across China. The Group’s financial and operational footprint spans Asia, Europe, and parts of Russia.
categories.supply_chain_position: Beijing Enterprises Holdings Limited operates across the upstream, midstream, and downstream segments of the gas supply chain, including upstream oil and gas exploration (via VCNG), midstream pipeline transmission (via PipeChina Beijing Pipeline), and downstream distribution and sales. In water and environmental sectors, it operates primarily in midstream and downstream activities, including plant construction, operation, and service provision. The Beer Business covers production and distribution downstream. The Group integrates vertically in gas and extends horizontally in environmental and water services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The Group’s strategic focus includes building the 'Four Strongholds' in business layout, value creation, mechanism reform, and talent pooling to drive high-quality development. It emphasizes innovation in green and low-carbon technologies, digital transformation, and operational efficiency. R&D initiatives target new energy, carbon capture and utilization, environmental protection technologies, and smart water management. The Group also pursues light-asset transformation in water business and technological upgrades in environmental operations to enhance sustainability and competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale and distribution of natural gas, LNG trading, water supply and sewage treatment services, solid waste treatment and energy sales (electricity, steam, heat), and beer product sales. The Group also earns income from construction services under service concession arrangements, equipment sales, and licensing. Revenue recognition occurs at point of sale or over time for services rendered. Dividend income from associates and government grants also contribute to income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The Group is a leading integrated urban public utility company in China, holding dominant positions in city gas supply (Beijing Gas is the largest single city gas supplier in China), water treatment (BE Water is the largest integrated water company in China), and environmental services (BE Environment and EEW GmbH are major players in solid waste treatment domestically and in Europe). Yanjing Brewery ranks among the top three beer brands in China. The Group competes with other large state-owned and private enterprises in utilities, environmental services, and beverage industries, leveraging its scale, technology, and government backing.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the Group reported revenue of approximately RMB84.06 billion, a 2.1% increase year-on-year, with profit attributable to shareholders of RMB5.12 billion, up 5.0% excluding one-off impacts. EBITDA was RMB14.21 billion. Total assets reached RMB209.75 billion, with shareholders’ equity of RMB84.88 billion. The Group maintains a stable growth trajectory with diversified business segments contributing to steady revenue and profit growth. It has optimized its debt structure, reduced finance costs, and maintained strong credit ratings (AAA domestic, A from Fitch, BBB+ from Moody’s).
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The Group emphasizes providing high-quality, reliable, and sustainable urban public utility services aligned with national strategies such as carbon peak and carbon neutrality. It differentiates through comprehensive integration of gas, water, environmental, and beer businesses, leveraging advanced technologies, extensive infrastructure networks, and strong government support. The Group’s focus on innovation, digital transformation, and green development enhances operational efficiency and customer satisfaction. Its scale, industry leadership, and commitment to ESG principles position it as a trusted provider contributing to better urban living and sustainable development.
